Set character limits and overlap, then read the chunks returned with the extraction result.

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ChunkerType, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, ExtractionConfig, extract } from "@xberg-io/xberg";
async function main() {
  const input: ExtractInput = { kind: ExtractInputKind.Uri, mimeType: "text/plain", uri: "https://example.com/text/book_war_and_peace_1p.txt" };
  const config: ExtractionConfig = { chunking: { chunkerType: ChunkerType.Text, maxChars: 300, maxOverlap: 40, trim: true } };
  const result = await extract(input, config);
  console.log(result.results?.[0]?.chunks);
}

void main();
```
